# Lumera LLM Overview

## Product
Lumera is an AI-powered SaaS that helps users recover from visa refusals. 
The platform analyzes official visa refusal letters, extracts exactly why the visa was denied based on immigration logic, and generates complete appeal packages.

## Features
- AI Refusal Analysis: Understand exactly why the visa was refused.
- Embassy-Ready Visa Reapplication Submissions: Formal structure covering legal burdens of proof.
- Personalized Document Checklists: A roadmap of evidence required for a successful reapplication.
- Country-specific logic (Schengen, UK, US, Canada, Australia).

## Pricing
- Starter: $9.99
- Standard: $19.99
- Premium: $34.99

## Purpose
Our goal is to level the playing field and stop people from wasting money on generic templates and expensive consultants when structural logic can solve most common visa refusals.

## Documentation
For information on our approach, see our intelligence guides at https://visaappealbuilder.com/guides
